programme.desc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘——菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #6
programme.desc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #4
programme.desc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一。

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒: 為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #3
programme.desc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #5
programme.desc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #7
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #8
programme.desc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上。

programme.title: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
programme.desc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。

programme.title: 沖繩島戰役彩色紀錄
programme.desc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。

programme.title: 發現號穿梭機的最後任務
programme.desc: 在發現號穿梭機開始最終航行前,先慶祝它非凡的過去。見證這個感情洋溢的任務,看看這架堅固但脆弱的穿梭機能否抵達首府華盛頓。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 #4
programme.desc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #1
programme.desc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #2
programme.desc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #3
programme.desc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事。儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
programme.desc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
programme.desc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉。在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索。

programme.title: 女神們 #2
programme.desc: 在荷里活以「鐵蝴蝶」聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽。

programme.title: 女神們 #3
programme.desc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片。

programme.title: 女神們 #4
programme.desc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音、令人興奮的舞台表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈。

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #2
programme.desc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場。

programme.desc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: 當一名 21 歲的年輕人在疫情高峰期失蹤後,洛杉磯警局(LAPD)的偵探們從被刪除的監視錄影中解開謎團,成功偵破這起謀殺案。

programme.title: 吉米法倫今夜秀 13 #88

programme.desc: 阿尼絲的話造成跟安治阿的衝突;德蘭必須扭盡六壬為戴安娜的女兒找到一個住處;伊莉莎伯塔病了幾天才能入院,這闡述了更為嚴重的事。

programme.title: NCIS S21 #2
programme.desc: 海軍犯罪調查局為德奇的死哀悼,探員們在處理他手頭未完成的一宗案件時感到安慰,那涉及一名婦女的父親,他被海軍陸戰隊褫奪職權。

programme.title: 微光城市-黑暗之光首部曲
programme.desc: 微光市是200年前人類所建造的避難所。現在,為城市供電的大型發電機正在失效,隨著耀眼的燈光開始閃爍和變暗,微光市陷入一片黑暗。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #1
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心。米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親。泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #2
programme.desc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫。在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出���面。經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧。青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴。米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點。一張熟悉的面孔回歸了。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #6
programme.desc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通「拳法之道」的專家。丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火。在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #7
programme.desc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課。強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #8
programme.desc: 一個爭奪國際頂尖賽事名額的機會引發了道館間的激戰。多莉的忠誠度受到考驗。珊則難以放下米格爾。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #9
programme.desc: 多莉為她的反抗付出了代價。魟魚正與他的良知搏鬥。強尼、丹尼爾和喬善在城裡的慶祝之夜發生了意外轉折。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #10
programme.desc: 山谷區爆發了一場決戰之夜,強尼、丹尼爾、喬善和他們的學生們集結了所有的技能與力量,誓要揭發並擊垮泰瑞。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。

programme.desc: 在全世界見證蘇聯將首位女性送上月球之後,尼克森總統要求美國做出解釋。太空人辦公室主任迪克·斯雷頓的任務是組建並訓練一批女性太空人,以扳回一城。莫莉·科布、帕蒂·多伊爾、艾倫·韋弗利、丹妮爾·普爾和特蕾西·史蒂文斯(戈爾多·史蒂文斯的妻子)接受了嚴格的訓練,期間她們之間既有結盟,也有衝突。

programme.title: 太空使命 #4

programme.desc: 一次訓練事故後,關於女性是否應該被允許成為太空人的全國性辯論爆發。迪克·斯雷頓為該計劃辯護,並在未經美國宇航局官員許可的情況下公開宣布了首批女宇航員名單。為了讓第一位登上月球的美國女性讓路,戈爾多史蒂文斯被從阿波羅15號任務中除名。月球衛星影像顯示可能存在水,這對於計劃中的美國月球基地至關重要;下一次阿波羅任務的任務被重新分配,以尋找水源。艾倫·韋弗利和她的朋友、美國宇航局的技術員拉里·威爾遜分享了一個秘密。

programme.title: 太空使命 #5
programme.desc: 當NASA在沙克爾頓隕石坑發現疑似月球冰的證據時,阿波羅15號的太空人決定更改著陸點。回到地球後,莫莉的嬉皮士丈夫韋恩和循規蹈矩的妻子凱倫·鮑德溫一開始並不合拍,但隨著他們對各自宇航員配偶命運的擔憂日益加劇,兩人的關係也逐漸升溫。特蕾西則努力平衡太空人的職責和母親的角色。

programme.desc: 烏野高中排球社逐步進行全國大賽的準備,影山和月島分別收到全日本青年強化集訓與宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的召集消息。沒被選中的日向則擅自參加後者的集訓。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #2
programme.desc: 為了成為名留歷史的壞女人,艾莉西亞每日勤奮不懈,不僅努力追求知識,也重視在實地的親見親聞,她因而前往被魔法隔離的羅亞納村。沒想到在當地等著她的是足以左右她人生的一場相遇!

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #11
programme.desc: 眼看圭護的運動鞋就要被搶走時監志出手幫助了他。襲擊圭護的男人利用了具有興奮作用的珠珠糖增強自己的力量及欲望。據說散播珠珠糖的是人稱「狼」的人物,而使用珠珠糖作亂的那些人則被稱為「狗」。另一方面,自稱是魔女的宮尾音夢出現在妮可和守仁面前。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #12
programme.desc: 原來真神圭護就是「狼」!他在看見三日月的形狀後,變身成為具有凶暴性及野性力量的強悍狼人,對守仁展開襲擊。在這個時候,與守仁分頭行動的妮可和監志被狼手下的「狗」團團包圍。兩人約定妮可負責搜索想對自己下手的魔女,監志則在發現魔女後展開攻擊。

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-誰可以如此愛我?濟良娃娃愛的故事

programme.title: 靈修早晨

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天2 藝人,警察,過來人
programme.desc: 在社會上有三類人,他們的故事往往起伏跌宕,引人注目。n藝人─身處五光十色的娛樂圈,昨日一炮而紅,今天卻隨時一沉百踩,明天,是黯淡無光抑或光輝璀璨?n員警─衝鋒陷陣,與死亡正面交鋒的職業,在捍衛他人生命和財產,讓市民有美好明天時,自己的明天又能否好好捍衛?n過來人─昔日在黑道中打混,見盡各種腥風血雨的

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地紅蔥頭味道香濃，用作配料或製作醬料同樣合適。鼎爺將海味、香料、醬料三大類材料放入攪拌器打蓉，再慢慢炒勻，「自家製沙茶醬」可謂零失敗！芥蘭取出蘭度，與嫩滑牛柳同炒，再加入沙茶醬調味，即成滋味菜式。火腩帶有油香，腓排亦具鮮味。「春菜排骨煲」的春菜吸盡兩種香味，更是精華所在。阿爺及後將蟹膏、蟹肉與肉餅拌勻，並一同蒸煮，帶來外觀、味道兼備的「膏蟹蒸肉餅」。將豬肉肉餅分別剁成蓉和碎粒，還有助提升口感。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血壓測量到甚麼數字代表血壓高？心臟科醫生還提到，狀況有可能導致嚴重併發症！患者一般都要長期服藥，而降血壓藥分為五大類，需注意相關副作用。醫生亦提供有助預防高血壓的生活習慣建議。據指逾半數男性長者都有前列腺肥大問題，也擔憂會引致患癌，有甚麼相關檢查？前列腺肥大會壓住尿道致小便困難，如服藥療效欠理想，又有何新型手術可助病人解困？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅參考日式天婦羅的做法，炮製一道「金沙酒香杏鮑菇」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 汕頭之旅新一集，祖藍不止坐低等食，還提出要跟兩位頂流潮菜大師學藝，嘗試烹調幾道經典潮菜。大師給他的首要任務是買食材，「過海」、「帶靴」究竟是甚麼？展示「豆醬煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剝開蟹蓋，不愧為大師！還有「滷水乳鴿」、「鮮蝦釀吊瓜」，祖藍統統都學會了！入夜，祖藍走進火鍋店一試滷水火鍋，配鵝材同吃，夠濃味。不過，祖藍更推介店內的老菜脯粥底火鍋，也可配以鮮美的海鮮；但為何粥底內不見米飯？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#18粵
programme.desc: 兆明日以繼夜照顧昏迷的司徒嵐，秀瓊看在眼內深受感動。曉盈買鑽石表獎勵自己坐上CEO位置，威龍提醒她無須爬到山頂。威龍帶麗娟探望秀瓊，秀瓊坦言要照顧女兒，同時不忘守護鼎福和。秀瓊看到兆明頹廢，曉以大義鼓勵他振作。百喜昇召開記招交代鼎福和未來發展，竇彰指收購的事仍未下定案。曉盈不滿威龍站在竇彰一方，威龍坦言在幫她。司徒嵐甦醒，卻完全失去對兆明的記憶，視他為陌路人；醫生指司徒嵐有可能永遠失去記憶……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 一織釐清陸的特質後，明白到是其哀求人的表情產生的效果，於是決心要令陸感到幸福滿足。大和等人上門探望TRIGGER，龍之介勸壯五與家人和好，環卻表現激動，更要出手打人，天見狀叫他一起出去買食物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 人口普查收集人口數據，原來香港有團體推行「麻雀普查」？「Kids’ Notes」請來團體代表述說相關普查細節。在港可見的麻雀主要有三種，包括樹麻雀、家麻雀、山麻雀，各有甚麼特色？嘉賓還談及麻雀如何用乾沙「洗澡」。另外，香港不時有野鴿聚集，但原來大多都不是本地原生，而是外來物種？珠頸斑鳩則是香港原生雀鳥，頸上的斑點就是其特徵！常說「麻鷹捉雞仔」，麻鷹也會在天空盤旋尋找食物，但牠們的主要食糧並非雞仔？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐誤信蜻蛉戲言，吃下山羊糞，成為島民笑柄。蜻蛉用高爾夫球桿打棒球，更把切刺身的方法應用到高球上，其控球技術再度令五十嵐驚訝。五十嵐發現蜻蛉缺乏鬥心，但他卻想讓對方參加比賽。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 油麻地有新盤交樓，窗邊防水膠條沒裝妥，地板也有罅隙及拱起，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 婆婆疑被路面沙井蓋絆倒而受傷，有關機構可有回應？長者乘車優惠將於4月3日起調整為「兩蚊兩折」，節目組搶先一探市民看法，並帶來精明乘車貼士。屯門某屋邨業主接獲管理處書信通知，指樓下投訴其單位喉管漏水，要求事主於限期內安排師傅檢查及維修。工程期間，事主向樓下住戶查詢，對方卻稱沒投訴兼沒漏水？管理處一方的回覆更令事主感到不滿！黎明於演唱會尾場，細說愛上音樂的由來，以及向樂迷送紅蘿蔔手燈的意義。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2776粵
programme.desc: Elaine偶然發現Venus向壯表白，壯則稱需要時間考慮再作答覆。Elaine與若水商議此事，被Ceci聽到，她建議Elaine寫情書表白。壯收到情書，終知悉Elaine的心意，滿心歡喜；原本一切順利，她卻因遺忘某事情而功虧一簣。Ceci再向她獻計，打算讓壯英雄救美，以製造表白機會。壯接到Elaine的訊息，得悉她有危險，竟未現身相救，也無回覆。Elaine懷疑壯正往見Venus，欲給她答覆……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#3粵PG
programme.desc: 邵文處理一宗家暴案，勾起自身回憶；童年的邵文與姊姊邵玲飽受母親毒打，邵玲為保護弟弟大義滅親。邵玲這次希望邵文的判決可令案中施暴父親付出代價，但事情其後出現變數……邵玲對邵文的判決感到不解，姊弟關係降至冰點。離島三少年在山頭活埋同學，此案由惠知接手審理。淑樺為其中一名被告辯護，提出三人只是受島上惡霸談卓飛唆擺作惡，犯案主謀應是卓飛。惠知、淑樺再次交鋒，二人都想起因麗慈母子而起的往事……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉瀾叫楚楚不要浪費時間，楚楚那邊的人到不了，但是他們的奇兵要到了。瑾璃帶人過來，路上遇到毒蟲，幸好楚楚早就研製出能驅散毒蟲的藥粉。祐辰安三人跑進廟裡，楚楚等人驅散毒蟲後再進去時，他們已經從地道跑了。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 「90後女廚師」鄭紫欣擅長煮西餐，看過西安人製作當地的特色油潑麵後靈感迸發，加入西式食材，做出「西班牙辣肉腸蒜蝦肉燥麵」。紫欣顯技即席拉麵條，還應要求邊拉麵邊轉身，猶如某餐廳的師傅親臨表演，功架十足。蹺腳牛肉是四川樂山市在地美食，啟發家鋌師傅帶來「沸藤清湯牛腩」。粵菜中用蘿蔔、香料等燜煮的清湯腩，食用前淋上加熱的花椒油，能提升香氣層次。烹調過程中，祖儀這廚壇新手又發出甚麼妙語，讓師傅無言以對？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#36粵
programme.desc: 少龍偷入魏營救秦兵，暴露了身分，幸得龍陽君相救。此時信陵君率眾來搜，還取出魏王的御賜金牌……廷芳與善柔在渡頭救起漂浮江中的人，認出是少龍。廷芳自稱鳳菲，不肯跟少龍相認。不韋取笑嬴政將多出一個便宜弟郎，嬴政怒氣沖沖到大鄭宮，太醫指出朱姬有了身孕。嬴政要嫪毐護送不韋往巡視長城，伺機殺他。嬴政強行灌朱姬飲墮胎湯藥時，趙高突然來報指嫪毐事敗，嬴政為怕觸怒不韋，任由他處置嫪毐。嫪毐強忍劇痛，吃力爬上高樓。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 婆婆疑被路面沙井蓋絆倒而受傷，有關機構可有回應？長者乘車優惠將於4月3日起調整為「兩蚊兩折」，節目組搶先一探市民看法，並帶來精明乘車貼士。屯門某屋邨業主接獲管理處書信通知，指樓下投訴其單位喉管漏水，要求事主於限期內安排師傅檢查及維修。工程期間，事主向樓下住戶查詢，對方卻稱沒投訴兼沒漏水？管理處一方的回覆更令事主感到不滿！黎明於演唱會尾場，細說愛上音樂的由來，以及向樂迷送紅蘿蔔手燈的意義。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血壓測量到甚麼數字代表血壓高？心臟科醫生還提到，狀況有可能導致嚴重併發症！患者一般都要長期服藥，而降血壓藥分為五大類，需注意相關副作用。醫生亦提供有助預防高血壓的生活習慣建議。據指逾半數男性長者都有前列腺肥大問題，也擔憂會引致患癌，有甚麼相關檢查？前列腺肥大會壓住尿道致小便困難，如服藥療效欠理想，又有何新型手術可助病人解困？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅參考日式天婦羅的做法，炮製一道「金沙酒香杏鮑菇」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 汕頭之旅新一集，祖藍不止坐低等食，還提出要跟兩位頂流潮菜大師學藝，嘗試烹調幾道經典潮菜。大師給他的首要任務是買食材，「過海」、「帶靴」究竟是甚麼？展示「豆醬煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剝開蟹蓋，不愧為大師！還有「滷水乳鴿」、「鮮蝦釀吊瓜」，祖藍統統都學會了！入夜，祖藍走進火鍋店一試滷水火鍋，配鵝材同吃，夠濃味。不過，祖藍更推介店內的老菜脯粥底火鍋，也可配以鮮美的海鮮；但為何粥底內不見米飯？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#18粵
programme.desc: 兆明日以繼夜照顧昏迷的司徒嵐，秀瓊看在眼內深受感動。曉盈買鑽石表獎勵自己坐上CEO位置，威龍提醒她無須爬到山頂。威龍帶麗娟探望秀瓊，秀瓊坦言要照顧女兒，同時不忘守護鼎福和。秀瓊看到兆明頹廢，曉以大義鼓勵他振作。百喜昇召開記招交代鼎福和未來發展，竇彰指收購的事仍未下定案。曉盈不滿威龍站在竇彰一方，威龍坦言在幫她。司徒嵐甦醒，卻完全失去對兆明的記憶，視他為陌路人；醫生指司徒嵐有可能永遠失去記憶……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 蔣志光與韋綺姍再度合唱<相逢何必曾相識，人氣不減當年！湯寶如夥拍後輩關楚耀合唱一曲，還與蔣志光合唱其首本名曲<相思風雨中。彭健新、林欣彤、馮允謙、文佩玲、胡渭康亦以不同方式配搭，演唱經典合唱歌曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到游一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們登上小艇，享用「避風塘」招牌炒肉蟹、炒蜆美食，鼎爺還提起避風塘上的第一次約會。鼎爺購入一隻大龍蝦，起殼後要阿譚將龍蝦殼及蝦殼一起熬煮，做出濃蝦湯來炒伊麵。備用的龍蝦肉則連同荷蘭豆、百合、白玉木耳等配菜一起爆炒，鑊氣十足！二人另到果園摘香蕉，暢談香蕉適宜食用的時機。返回廚房，沒有蕉葉，轉用荷葉鋪上蒸籠，巧製一道「荷葉粉蒸肉」。阿譚想採用糯米粉替代炒勻糯米及粘米，卻未為拍檔接受，有何原因？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨床腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五拿著資料去遊說環讓他回家，環最終放行。ZOOL上去《Next Re:vale》做嘉賓，前半段一言不發，虎於企圖用筆嚇千卻被百反制，四人屈服配合節目進行，事後百把電話號碼交給對方。壯五回到家裡，與父親對峙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，Ban Sir率先帶領大家進行基礎體適能訓練。他指出，這些動作能有效提升協調、反應與速度，不僅有助日常運動表現，對做家務、行樓梯亦大有裨益。此外，小朋友亦可透過踢腿、交叉步等動作，增強平衡力與下肢肌肉。節目還會播出AI生成動畫《星星的銀幣》的下半部份，大家也要學習故事內小女孩的無私愛心，向身邊人傳遞溫暖和關懷。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 同學七海拾到一個星光兔的袋子，走來詢問陽葵是否她的，就在這時，另一位同學鈴夢則說這個袋子是她妹妹的，還強調自己身為模特兒對星光兔沒興趣。儘管如此，陽葵還是想和鈴夢交朋友，二人更開始熟絡起來……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是常見的都市病，在西方國家很普通，越來越多香港人亦患上此病，部分人甚至不知道已患上糖尿病，其實糖尿病就是人體的胰臟，不能分泌足夠的胰島素，或者胰島素失去應有的功能，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1991年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2777粵
programme.desc: 敢威、尚善與力蓮碰巧同時休假，無法聯絡得上。某項目臨時改為公開招標，作為最高決策人的璟風遂召集相關人員商議可要調整標價，卻未有定論，幸有人想到拖延之策。為免再出現高層真空狀況，璟風建議預早請假並互通消息，獲敢威同意。敢威打算兩星期後乘郵輪度假，怎料力蓮、尚善已申請休假，還似乎勢在必行，他只好取消行程，家聰卻提出另類解決方案。敢威對主管及以上級別推行新請假政策，意圖阻止力蓮休假，卻引發不少問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#4粵PG
programme.desc: 「離島三害案」尋回的兇器上，證實還有卓飛的DNA。惠知打算調查「第四名疑犯」卓飛的去向，並要求邵玲幫忙，終發現驚人內情。回到庭上，在惠知與檢控官林雅晴的追問下，最終揭出案件的殘酷真相！惠知藉判詞指出家長盲目包庇，令犯罪少年一錯再錯，淑樺聽出其用意，心情鬱悶。光正之女邱天雪，希望促成父親與惠知和好，卻事與願違。淑樺接到保鏢通知，指成彬不知去向，令淑樺大為緊張……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 冷月帶著藥材來交州支援楚楚，並幫忙用止痛粉替病人去掉壁蝨，楚楚從中得到啟發，決定剖腹取蟲。祐辰安在兩國和談上設局刺殺祐龍晟，又用藥使南趙王病重，趁機代理朝政。得知藥材不足，楚父便動身前往山貨市集採買。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 在四川，臘肉會加甚麼香料醃製？當地人還會故意把臘肉燒到變焦，再刮走表面燒焦一層，所為何事？世韜師傅概述四川臘肉與廣式臘肉之別，隨後用不同臘肉、臘腸炮製「四川臘味煲仔飯」；臘味頭頭尾尾亦不浪費，連同冰糖、生抽、老抽來煮出煲仔飯豉油，絕對夠美味！遼寧本溪有過百間賣烤豆皮的店舖，食材廉價簡單，濃味好吃的背後卻是工序多多！人氣女主廚紫欣教觀眾在家輕鬆「複製」，奉上「煙燻烤豆皮」，但對祖儀來說似乎不易……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#37粵
programme.desc: 嫪毐以嬴政身世秘密要脅他確保一家三口安全。廷芳心緒不寧，排舞錯漏百出，少龍教她跳西班牙舞，二人關係轉好。廷芳在齊王面前表演後，突然有殺手跳出刺殺齊王，劍劃過廷芳的背。廷芳自知中毒垂危，向少龍剖白愛意，少龍承諾待她復元後娶她。少龍推測齊相田單籌劃刺殺行動，與善柔夜探田府，揭穿主公是齊墨鉅子曹秋道，秋道以善柔性命及解藥交換鉅子令秘笈。嫪毐與嬴政探望朱姬，嬴政的態度和善，原來嫪毐找來假嬴政密謀頂包秦王。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨床腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到游一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一玩，在婚宴場地玩一番，由「垃圾之最」連詩雅、朱智賢鬥倒霉抽隊員，兩人的行為總是令人摸不著頭腦。大玩隊與特玩隊進行一對一單挑，蝦頭與楊潮凱造就「同姓一吻」；陳嘉桓、林秀怡竟出動肥肉搶鏡；翟威廉與朱智賢大鬥反應，威廉勝出卻輸風度！「開口中」遊戲談起情侶間的暱稱，眾人戀情被Bob擺上檯，為何最後區永權要接受吃辣飯的懲罰？藝員搶花球爭獎品，有甚麼東西令蝦頭感動流涕？慰勞宴上，眾人分享最難忘的事。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 關楓馨首次單獨和爸爸關禮傑去旅行，安排了海景酒店，希望可一起看日出。兩人先挑戰揚帆出海，父女合作操控風帆，漸見默契。楓馨又帶爸爸夜遊惠州年輕人蒲點，嘗試夾公仔，也換上泳裝享受溫泉樂。翌日享用早餐後，父女登高觀賞雙月灣美景，還駕駛越野車漫遊沙灘。楓馨特意為爸爸準備內地網紅最新的打卡活動— 圍爐煮茶，兩人互相替對方拍照，傑爸的攝影姿勢與技術卻似乎被嫌棄！入夜，父女摸着酒杯深入對談，楓馨緣何觸動落淚？

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 楓馨偕爸爸獨遊，擔心媽媽會呷醋，因此親自調製香水送贈母親「補飛」。及後和爸爸會合吃飯，楓馨還溫馨餵他進食。關氏父女接着以高卡車競速分勝負，完賽後談感受，傑哥一份感動湧上心頭，所為何事？來到惠州的海鮮街大擦一頓，父女互相點菜許諾回家後為對方下廚。惠州之行臨近尾聲，楓馨要求爸爸為她策劃的這次旅程評分，竟只得八十分？父女兩人又會訴說對這趟旅程的感受、得着，傑哥還暗中為女兒準備了一份窩心禮物，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反唇相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 金雕、玉雕、牙雕已成夕陽行業，一班手藝非凡的老師傅，如何為這些傳統工藝「守尾門」？一塊金磚，由熔金到打磨，每個步驟都要一絲不苟，打金師傅胡文楷卻稱學習了「批、鑲、卓、鑿」已稱得上滿師，但要怎樣才能獨當一面？經過師傅悉心設計，一塊石頭，隨時會變成價值連成的寶玉！何以香蕉、燒肉、龍蝦等亦能成為精緻的玉器擺設？牙雕業在國際實施象牙禁運後面臨重大衝擊，何以朱忠盛仍堅持守護這門即將絕跡的手藝？

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚到塔門與漁民捉海鮮，有甚麼收穫？接着鼎爺以海膽蒸蛋白及炒飯，將原片海膽與蛋白同蒸，想蛋白蒸起來更幼滑有何秘訣？鼎爺製作炒飯時特意選用蛋白帶出海膽的鮮味，為何海膽要分兩次下鑊？鼎爺與阿譚品嚐過塔門住家菜，再帶來兩道海鮮菜式。先炮製「鮑魚綠豆沙」，這道「豪華」糖水有何來歷？糖水中的「西米棟楝」是甚麼？鼎爺又以荷包魷切幼絲，配搭蝦醬、蔬菜炒麵，留意下材料的先後次序，令魷魚嫩滑不致韌。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 有三兄弟繼承了父親的砂鍋粥路邊攤，發展成砂鍋粥店，更標明即點即煮即宰。粥內有肉蟹、鮑魚、蟶子，足料非常，也滿載鮮味；椒鹽鷓鴣等伴粥小菜亦不容錯過！踏進小吃街，祖藍又有任務了！買齊反沙番薯芋、無米粿、鱟粿、橄欖油甘甘蔗汁、酸菜豬肚湯五種小食，認識小吃歷史之外，還找來小朋友為他現場即學的潮汕話評分呢！祖藍接着到步行街逛夜市，順道為家中三位女士搜羅禮物，有檔主專誠為祖藍兩位千金設計簡單名牌，不得不買啦！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)竇彰盼曉盈將五成半股權賣回給竇家，讓他們延續傳統精神。百喜昇受醜聞影響，股價不斷下跌。司徒嵐忽然記起《哥士的殺手》故事內容及意外情景，頭痛不已。秀瓊認錯鄰家是自己的家，兆明提議她做檢查。蔣生要曉盈對鼎福和事件負全責，並將鼎福和的股份全賣回竇家。竇彰邀同業加入鼎福和，各人表示愛莫能助……德正參加沙沙舞比賽被美娜奚落，仍堅持站在舞台，並找來丹丹做舞伴。兆明帶秀瓊看醫生，證實她患腦退化症……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子隨爸爸晚上巡區提高防火意識，事後到居酒屋小休，其間得以窺探成年人的世界。小玉不小心弄壞盛載其父母回憶的音樂盒，去鐘錶店找人修理但不果，小丸子提議她學習用鋼琴把曲子彈奏出來。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五向父親說出內心想法，但後者不理，更借故誣陷環傷人，要脅壯五放棄演藝活動。壯五獨個兒主持電台節目，其間透露自己的過去，更播出TRIGGER的歌。環前來迎接壯五，在車上告訴他其父親已答允請求。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 復活節有甚麼象徵物件？導師在「Artspiration」教大家繪畫色彩繽紛的應節元素。畫紙右方有一個籃，用來盛起不同大小、顏色的復活蛋；至於左方及籃後，都可以畫出可愛得意、耳朵長長的復活兔。跟着導師的指引，繪畫過程相信會容易得多。如小朋友遇到一些困難的事情，經「開心SHARE」過後，說不定也可找到輕鬆面對的方法！主持們是怎樣克服數學功課與課堂作文的「難關」？Emily姐姐還試過以跳舞代替部份默書？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 美月在早晨直播時，說起「想趁今年內做到的事」，陽葵希望自己的廚藝有所進步，而美月則想克服最害怕的跳箱。陽葵見狀，決定為美月進行特訓，可是美月仍然對跳箱充滿恐懼，怎麼都跳不過去……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 日出康城一個1,500平方呎單位，如何把中式古董收藏品，融入現代設計風格？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2778粵
programme.desc: 樹根生日將至，適逢他擔任金剛門掌門十周年，打算邀請各地分館門人參與壽宴。城安等人忙於安排各項事宜，卻知悉樹根任期將滿，快將退位，懷疑他大事舖張另有所圖。聯絡海外門人並不順利，樹根責怪眾人辦事不力。尚善託潮偉查得海外多間分館已結束，門人四散，眾人於是取消壽宴，改為自行慶祝。生日當天，樹根以為壽宴如期舉行，滿心期待，眾人只好設法補救。出於某些原因，樹根被困家中。得悉麻煩盡消，眾人欣喜之際卻另有發現……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#5粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知審理一宗盜竊案，被告竟是當日意外開槍擊斃麗慈的警員何偉迪……偉迪一直愧疚，終鼓起勇氣探望麗慈的遺孤芳芳，偉迪再向惠知探問案件真相。邵文的母親冼勵梅被指「碰瓷」扮撞車敲詐，而被告上法庭，邵文自覺顏面無存，勵梅卻毫無悔意！凍肉店發現初生嬰兒屍體，女店主的女兒麥珊珊被控殺嬰罪，珊珊卻堅持不說出嬰兒爸爸是誰，裁判官洪思義覺得另有內情。宇澤的忌日，惠知往現場拜祭時，與淑樺狹路相逢……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 辰安派人抓走楚平以威逼楚楚前往南趙，進而迫使瑾瑜答應出使南趙重啟和談。瑾瑜見虛弱的南趙王完全受制於辰安，看出其想借大唐之力順利繼位之野心,便暗示藩王未死，無法強行冊封，另一邊廂瑾瑜又秘密約見李璋…

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 透過片段了解雲南傣族的孔雀宴後，小儀師傅嘗試以「焗爐燒腩仔」重現碳火烤肉的美味。她用焗爐烤出香脆外皮，還分享保持肉汁的秘訣，關鍵是一張紙巾。另邊廂，祖儀不僅向永權敬「流水酒」，還唱歌助興？雲南西雙版納盛產茶葉，以茶入饌更是當地特色。家鋌師傅借鑑煮出「茶燻秘製豉油雞」，以茶燻香氣轟炸主持們的味蕾！想不到只需茶葉、白米、砂糖三種材料，就可帶來滋味效果。此外，祖儀好學詢問生抽、豉油的分別，卻釀成笑話？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#38粵
programme.desc: 嬴政野心勃勃，計劃十年內一統六國。嬴政將剛離母體的嬰兒掐死。嫪毐怒然挾持嬴政欲殺他，嬴政與趙高雙雙跳崖。少龍突然心緒不寧，再見銅鏡中影像模糊。嫪毐將真正兒子交給朱姬，原來他早已調包嬰兒。不韋見嬴政與朱姬突然關係轉好，隱覺不妥。琴清得悉少龍無恙回來，飛奔往渡頭接他，見他與廷芳態度親暱，錯愕。少龍奇怪二女沒有酸風醋雨。少龍更衣入宮時，赫見嬴政暱藏房中。嬴政講出調包原委，滕翼來報指琴清被大王軟禁。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 有三兄弟繼承了父親的砂鍋粥路邊攤，發展成砂鍋粥店，更標明即點即煮即宰。粥內有肉蟹、鮑魚、蟶子，足料非常，也滿載鮮味；椒鹽鷓鴣等伴粥小菜亦不容錯過！踏進小吃街，祖藍又有任務了！買齊反沙番薯芋、無米粿、鱟粿、橄欖油甘甘蔗汁、酸菜豬肚湯五種小食，認識小吃歷史之外，還找來小朋友為他現場即學的潮汕話評分呢！祖藍接着到步行街逛夜市，順道為家中三位女士搜羅禮物，有檔主專誠為祖藍兩位千金設計簡單名牌，不得不買啦！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)竇彰盼曉盈將五成半股權賣回給竇家，讓他們延續傳統精神。百喜昇受醜聞影響，股價不斷下跌。司徒嵐忽然記起《哥士的殺手》故事內容及意外情景，頭痛不已。秀瓊認錯鄰家是自己的家，兆明提議她做檢查。蔣生要曉盈對鼎福和事件負全責，並將鼎福和的股份全賣回竇家。竇彰邀同業加入鼎福和，各人表示愛莫能助……德正參加沙沙舞比賽被美娜奚落，仍堅持站在舞台，並找來丹丹做舞伴。兆明帶秀瓊看醫生，證實她患腦退化症……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反唇相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 日日運動身體好，吳幸美竟教跆拳道學員「洗面盆學游泳」、「牀下底踢毽」？原來是為了講解「㜺鬼」歇後語。廣東道玉器街是香港七十年代的熱門「蒲點」，主持們到訪玉器店學習分辨玉器優劣，期間發現「玉器塗白漆－ 內中有寶」？農曆七月初七又叫「七姐節」、「乞巧節」，背後除了牛郎織女的深情故事，還另有文章！霓虹燈製作過程繁複，「楷師傅」三兩下手勢便做出「TVB光管」，果然是「半空中點燈－ 高招」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 「盂蘭節」是中國傳統的「鬼節」，善信自會備好各式祭品「做節」。眾主持前往餅店尋找「文化遺產」，幸美卻帶來探險裝備，可謂「抬棺材甩褲－ 失禮死人」。鄭寶鴻另會講解「拋三牲」、「散福」等習俗。洋服店老闆逾四十年來堅持手做西裝，功架十足堪稱「飛機上點燈－ 高明」。張惠雅還向老闆請教何謂「關公領」、「飛機領」，以及時下流行的西裝款式。「擔屎唔偷食」意指為人忠直老實，俗語背後原來隱藏自明朝流傳至今的誤解！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.desc: 淘氣鼠兄弟全新一季！鼠兄弟莫圖、蘭布、喬圖，和小狗小唐之間吵吵鬧鬧的歡樂故事，再度展開！這次，鼠兄弟們又會想出什麼整人的新點子呢？

programme.title: 淘氣鼠兄弟S3

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School

With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Bad Coffee
programme.desc: When Strickler tempts Jim to use dark magic in his training, it hits the school faculty in an unexpected way!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - So I'm Dating A Sorceress
programme.desc: Jim and his friends decide to take a night off for a double date, only to discover an uninvited fifth wheel.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Shocking Showdown of the Staggering Sugamechangere
programme.desc: It's parents' weekend at Lake Summer Camp, and Krupp's eager to make amends with Harold and George ... or so he says.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Depths
programme.desc: Lance and Hunk crash on a water planet and must rescue a mind-controlled mermaid civilization

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Shiro's Escape
programme.desc: The team sets off to a new planet where they hope to find information on Shiro's past

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Impatient Patient
programme.desc: While Spirit recovers from his injuries, Lucky helps out at the soda shop.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Monkeys Swing In The Trees
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Monkey used to play on the ground and he loved to wind up Crocodile. One day the Big Rains came and Monkey got stranded up the Mango Tree. Nasty Crocodile promised to take him to dry land…. But only in exchange for one thing…. His HEART! Monkey tricked Crocodile and when Crocodile found out that Monkey swapped his heart for a measley mango, he chased Monkey up a tree.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Tickbird Sits On Hippos Back
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Tickbird didn't sit on Hippo's back, infact they weren't friends at all! Tickbird was sick of Hippo splashing all the time. One day tiny Tickbird challenges big Hippo to a contest… who can drink the most water in a single gulp! Tickbird outwits Hippo by using the tides and from that day she is allowed to sit on Hippo's back and pick off all the yummy ticks she can eat! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Home Is Where The Hatch Is
programme.desc: Breeze and Roary swap places for the day (and night). Roary soon discovers the beach is no place for a racing car to live, while Breeze misses the freedom of the beach.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Putting On A Show
programme.desc: The cars are all gleaming for this evening's race. Roary gets bored and heads out onto the track - with disastrous consequences. Will the cars be ready in time for the big show?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Motor Mouth
programme.desc: The track inspector is coming to visit and Big Chris is too tired to commentate on the race. A celebrity commentator is brought in to save the day - much to Big Chris' anger.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Christine is due to take part in a dancing competition and is practising at Silver Hatch. But what happens when her dance partner is taken ill?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Homesick Tin Top
programme.desc: Tin Top just can't master corners no matter how hard he tries. The other cars try to help him to no avail… until Roary hits on a brilliant plan.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Save Our Tree
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning on cutting down Flash's tree. What can be done to save the poor rabbit's home?

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s "fun-crastinating" puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Monkey Planet
programme.desc: King Julien declares that lemurs will land on the moon and seeks help from a former astronaut: Stanislav, the Russian Space Monkey.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - True Bromance
programme.desc: When King Julien discovers that Maurice is moonlighting as adviser to another king, the two best friends break up.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Bedouin Shield
programme.desc: It’s revealed that Cleve is building a massive weather machine that is generating dangerous desert storms, with the help of a genius North African teen named Ziri. When Cleve creates a sandstorm to take out the crew, they’re saved by two Bedouin brothers named Kareem and Salem (and their pack of camels). Echo questions her ability to be a good leader and if they should give up.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Eye of the Sahara
programme.desc: The kids manage to make it through the crazy storm and build gliders out of parts of the fallen spy plane to travel closer to Cleve’s base and save Nowhere and Gary. Cleve sees the kids on his satellite feeds and sends a bunch of drones to take them out. During the aerial battle, Cisco splits off and leads the drones away so that the rest of the crew can escape, causing him to be lost alone in the giant storm

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Mom for a Day Kitty in the City
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. \ Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beans’s tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - The Itch To Switch Mismatched Socks
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. But as Scooch gets overwhelmed by all the activity at The Barker house, and Tag gets bored by the quiet life at the Pooch’s, they eagerly switch back before the day is done. \ When the Pawston Get Sox go on a losing streak, Tag and Scooch come up with the idea to have a team mascot.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Fly-A-Long Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tooth on the Loose That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 1
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, it's up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 2
programme.desc: Unaware of the war on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup, Snotlout and Johann discover an island full of dragons that have been wounded by the Dragon Hunters

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Problematic Pandemonium of the Punishing Plungerina
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bombastic Blathering of Brainy Blabulous
programme.desc: When Krupp transfers to another school, George and Harold follow, only to find a bizarro version of Jerome Horwitz Elementary, where the teachers are nice and the kids are well-behaved. But no one's having any fun! George and Harold want to right this wrong with pranks and comics. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer (bizarro Meaner), who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in order to stop the subversion of authority.

Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Vulture Is Bald
programme.desc: You see there was time when Vulture was not bald. Oh no, Vulture's head was covered in a beautiful crown of golden plumage! Vain Vulture never shut up about her golden feathers and was obsessed about making them ‘as golden as the sun!'. One day Vulture decides to fly up to the sun, but her precious feathers get burnt! Vulture decides to sooth her smoking feathers with golden honey which she steals from the bees. The bees are not pleased and Vulture sticks her head down Aardvark's burrow.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Giraffe Has A Long Neck
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Giraffe didn't have a long neck. Her neck was all short and stumpy and she was a very delicate eater. All the food in Tinga Tinga seemed to make her tummy go funny. Then one day Lion suggests she try some honey. With the Bees permission, Giraffe tries to lick the honey… but it is deep, deep inside the tree.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - High-Tech Overload

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Workshop Chaos

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Pit Stop Perils
